### Atomic data for astrophysics. I. Radiative recombination rates for H-like, He-like, Li-like and Na-like ions over a broad range of temperature. D. A. Verner & G. J. Ferland, 1996, ApJS, 103, 467.

Abstract. We present new calculations and analytic fits to the rates of radiative recombination towards H-like, He-like, Li-like and Na-like ions of all elements from H through Zn (Z=30). The fits are valid over a wide range of temperature, from 3 K to 10**9 K. PostScript file (352.2 K), Description of tables (3.3 K). 

- Table 1. Fit parameters for radiative recombination rates. ASCII (6.0 K) 
- Table 2. The partial radiative recombination rate coefficients for He I. ASCII (8.1 K) 
- Table 3. The partial radiative recombination rate coefficients for He-like ions. ASCII (71.1 K) 
- Table 4. The partial radiative recombination rate coefficients for Li-like ions. ASCII (63.7 K) 
- Table 5. The partial radiative recombination rate coefficients for Na-like ions. ASCII (36.5 K)
